reviews.title: Amazing value and color accuracy.
reviews.comment: The color accuracy paired with my macbook is fantastic. I use this monitor daily for photo editing and digital artwork. For the price, it really feels like a no brainer compared to something like an Apple studio display. Couple that with a screen thats incredibly easy on the eyes and you've got one hell of a monitor. I can't recommend enoough.
